name: Hyun Sohn
source:
Hyun is a young waiter at the Cosy Bear Café and a student at Antéros Academy.
 He’s extremely helpful and always ready to lend a hand. However, he can be shy in certain situations, particularly around the main character.

He enjoys evenings out with friends, spending time with his family.
However, he doesn't like laziness and horror films.
